verdict.rationale: Vanta has a dedicated Access Reviews product with pre-built content and guided workflows to run periodic reviews across connected apps, and claims up to 90% time savings, implying an in-platform reviewer workflow feeding the broader evidence collection system. However, the pack lacks explicit detail on reviewer sign-off UI mechanics or confirmation that review artifacts are automatically filed into the evidence library. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of reviewer attestation/sign-off flow and direct evidence-library linkage, plus independent/hands-on corroboration.
